title: Molecular Biology (MSc/PhD)
about: The University of Göttingen's integrated MSc/PhD programme in Molecular Biology, taught in English in Göttingen, Germany, accepts applications for the fall 2027 round through its online portal until January 15, 2027; shortlisted candidates are interviewed in January and February.
requirements: Generally 120 credits (ECTS or equivalent) at the time of application
card_alt: Card for the Molecular Biology (MSc/PhD) programme at the University of Göttingen (Georg-August-Universität Göttingen) in Göttingen, Germany, application deadline 15 Jan 2027. The background photo shows Cologne Cathedral and the Hohenzollern Bridge in Cologne, not Göttingen.
